content: memmap2 0.9.11 (2026-06-22) is the standard safe wrapper over mmap/mmap_mut on crates.io. remap()/RemapOptions can move the mapping (may_move); any Bytes/slice built from the old base pointer becomes dangling after a move - this is a real soundness hazard, not just an API nuisance, and is the reason segmented (never-remapped) files are the standard mitigation rather than growing one mapping in place.
